versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
versions.detection:
fsutil_clean_journal:
  Image: '*\fsutil.exe'
  CommandLine: '* deletejournal *'
pipe_com:
  CommandLine: '*\AppData\Local\Temp\* \\.\pipe\*'
event_clean:
  Image: '*\wevtutil.exe'
  CommandLine: '* cl *'
rundll32_dash1:
  Image: '*\rundll32.exe'
  CommandLine: '*.dat,#1'
perfc_keyword:
  - '*\perfc.dat*'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (Image="*\\fsutil.exe" CommandLine="* deletejournal *") OR CommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\* \\.\\pipe\*" OR (Image="*\\wevtutil.exe" CommandLine="* cl *") OR (Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine="*.dat,#1") OR "*\\perfc.dat*"

versions.subject: refactor: NotPetya rule
versions.detection:
selection_pattern:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'wevtutil cl Application & fsutil usn deletejournal /D C:'
        - 'dllhost.dat %WINDIR%\ransoms'
selection_rundll32_dash1:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - '.dat,#1'
        - '.dat #1' # Sysmon removes comma
        - '.zip.dll",#1'
selection_perfc_keyword:
    - '\perfc.dat'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*wevtutil cl Application & fsutil usn deletejournal /D C:*", "*dllhost.dat %WINDIR%\\ransoms*") OR (Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine IN ("*.dat,#1", "*.dat #1", "*.zip.dll\",#1")) OR "\\perfc.dat"
